Recommend main agent check backend logs for /challengers/*/message?finish=true and consider extending client timeout / adding a loading state on end-challenge-btn.

rca of the issue: OnboardingPage.js was refactored to extract WelcomeStep and FeaturesStep sub-components into /components/onboarding/OnboardingIntroSteps.js, but the corresponding `import { WelcomeStep, FeaturesStep } from '../components/onboarding/OnboardingIntroSteps'` line was never added. JSX `<WelcomeStep .../>` at line 169 and `<FeaturesStep .../>` at line 172 therefore reference undefined identifiers. Reproduction: (1) login any user, (2) visit /onboarding, (3) console shows 'ReferenceError: WelcomeStep is not defined at OnboardingPage'; the page renders no step 0/1 content and all onboarding-* testids are absent. Fix: add the missing named import statement matching whatever OnboardingIntroSteps.js actually exports (verify export names).
